final: WITH rating_avgs AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), above_overall AS (SELECT rating, avg_length FROM rating_avgs WHERE avg_length > (SELECT AVG(length) FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL)), above_rating_mean AS (SELECT rating, avg_length FROM above_overall WHERE avg_length > (SELECT AVG(avg_length) FROM rating_avgs)) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_remaining_avg_length, AVG(avg_length - (SELECT AVG(length) FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL)) AS avg_above_overall_mean, AVG(avg_length - (SELECT AVG(avg_length) FROM above_overall)) AS avg_above_passed_ratings_mean FROM above_rating_mean
